images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of VSpark.During training, (a) rollouts with calibrated action noise collect target supervision at perturbed states, and (b) feature alignment conditions and supervises the draft with target representations. During inference, (c) continuation reuse guides the next draft tree with target continuations along rejected branches. Strict verification checks all candidates under their current prefixes, preserving lossless decoding.

Figure 3:Illustration of continuation reuse.During verification in cyclett, the target also predicts along rejected branches. VSpark reuses them to build the tree for cyclet+1t+1, where they are re-verified.
